POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL superuser. The official postgres image requires the default superuser to be 'postgres' — setting a custom user breaks startup scripts that connect as 'postgres'.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated password for the application database user.

PGDATA.description: Must be a subdirectory of the volume mount point. Railway volumes contain lost+found, and initdb refuses to initialize when the mount point itself is used directly.

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: REQUIRED — run the container as root (uid 0). The official postgres image runs as uid 999, but Railway mounts the data volume root-owned, so a non-root process cannot write to it and crash-loops. Setting 0 boots every fresh install cleanly.
